label: OX40+
resolved_names: OX40 (TNFRSF4 / CD134)-expressing germinal center T follicular helper cell
evidence: Azimuth human_tonsil_v2 fine label 'OX40+' (order 179), source King HW et al. 2021 Sci Immunol (DOI 10.1126/sciimmunol.abh3768). OX40 is the protein product of TNFRSF4 (CD134), a costimulatory TNF-receptor superfamily member. In tonsil, OX40 is expressed on germinal-center-localised T follicular helper (GC-Tfh) cells, where OX40/OX40L signalling promotes Tfh differentiation, survival and B-cell helper function (Fu et al., 2021; Tahiliani et al., 2016). The label thus resolves to a germinal-center T cell (Tfh) subset, consistent with proposed CL parent CL:0009062 (germinal center T cell).
